t: The Living README: Architecting a Narrative-Driven Front Door
s: This article details the architectural vision for a 'living README.md' that acts as a master narrative, interactive table of contents, and single source of truth, using structured ASCII art blocks. It focuses on storytelling for diverse audiences, integrating AI, and treating documentation as a functional, testable component.
sub: README as a 'Paginatable Dictionary' of extractable ASCII art blocks.
Narrative sequencing for multiple audiences (new user, developer, financial/science).
WET (Write Everything Twice) methodology as AI-DRY.
Documentation as testable code coverage and feature demo.
Evolution of web indexing towards small-world crawlers and caching.
